An old captain hid some of his most precious belongings in the depths of Rookgaard. Go down through the {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} tower, cross the poisonous gases, face two {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and open the chests to receive salmon and the book {item:Treasure of Captain Iglue (Book)}. The salmon can be traded with {npc:Amber} for information about the orcs' language.
An old captain hid some of his most precious belongings deep in the island of Rookgaard.
Poison Spiders tower, north of Rookgaard
recommended for the Poison Gases; or enough Small Health Potions to withstand the poison
Optional: 12 {item:Salmon} and a {item:Stamped Letter} in the left chest (respawns daily).
Rookgaard's caves are almost all connected: there are several ways to this quest. This is the most direct one, not necessarily the safest.
There are {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields} and {item:Poison Gas|Poison Gases} along the way. An {item:Antidote Potion} cures the poison; {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions} are cheaper.
1. Go down through the Poison Spiders tower
Leave the village of **Rookgaard** and go **north** to the Poison Spiders tower (at the marked spot). Go in and go down a floor.
Go **south** and go down the first hole you find. Then go up at the spot to the **east** of you and head **north** to the next hole.
On this floor there are lots of {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and 2 {item:Poison Gas|Poison Gases}. Follow the path **northwest**, passing through the gases.
Path northwest through the Poison Gases
Use an {item:Antidote Potion} after you pass through the gases, or withstand the poison with {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions}.
Go down another floor. There are 3 Poison Spiders here.
Follow this passage and go down one more floor. There are no creatures here.
You arrive at an area with stone walls. Go down the {item:Stairs (White)|stairs}: you find two chests.
The chests are guarded by two {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}.

Kill the skeletons and open the chests. The **right** chest is the {item:Chest (Quest)|quest chest} and has 2 {item:Salmon}. The **left** chest has 12 Salmon and a {item:Stamped Letter}, but it is a {wiki:Daily Respawns|daily respawn}.

To leave, go back the same way: climb the white stairs and the floors you went down, using the {item:Rope} on the holes, and pass through the {item:Poison Gas|Poison Gases} again to the Poison Spiders tower, in the north of the island. From there, return to the village, to the **south**.
Keep an {item:Antidote Potion} (or Small Health Potions) for the gases on the way back.
Take the {item:Salmon} to {npc:Amber}, in the {wiki:Rookgaard Academy}. She swaps it for information about the {wiki:Orc Language|orc language}.
